Text Volume Chapter 557: Corruption With Violence

"I am already very generous..."

On April 15th, the 32nd day of the 32nd month of the Qin Dynasty, in Pengcheng, Sishui County, inside the palace that had been renovated and renovated from the former Song Dynasty Palace, some ministers thought that the rebellion in Linzi County might be due to the imperial court using the words of Hei Fu, the governor of Jiaodong County, to relocate in one fell swoop. When the eight Tian families in Jiaodong caused a backlash, they were reprimanded by Qin Shihuang. "In the past, the king of Qi used a strategy to defeat the envoys of Qin and wanted to cause chaos. I ordered General Wang Ben to kill him with soldiers, captured his king's building, and then leveled the land. This battle was not like the one that destroyed Chu, which lasted for months and months, and only lasted two days. Yue, there was no major battle, and he did not indiscriminately kill the Qidi Zhutian, and even let them live in the fields, hoping that they could each settle down in their respective positions and stabilize the place. However, how did the Qidi Zhutian repay me? Selling smuggled salt, colluding with pirates, in the fish and meat village, and even trying to assassinate someone in Junan! "

To the disappointment of many people, the assassination in Junan did not injure Qin Shihuang. He only knocked his foot when the car rolled over. The emperor, whose legs and feet were originally not very good, now walks even slower.

The emperor did not even change his itinerary because of this sudden assassination. After issuing oral orders to various places to intimidate Xiaoxiao, he continued to leave Donghai County and arrived in Pengcheng. I wanted to send people to Surabaya to look for the big cauldron that was said to have sunk here, but suddenly I heard that the Tian brothers in Di County, Linzi County were in trouble...

Qin Shihuang just frowned and sent it to the ministers for discussion as usual. However, among the ministers, there were different opinions on the nature of this turmoil.

Some people believe that ministers must not raise troops and mobilize crowds. Anyone who raises troops and crowds is a rebellion, not to mention that Tianjia has brazenly proclaimed himself king! This is a counterattack by the nobles of Qi who want to restore the country. The rebels must not be forgiven and the imperial court should immediately send troops to attack them.

However, some ministers believe that now that the country has been unified, the cities in all counties and counties have been razed, and all civilian weapons have been destroyed, indicating that they will no longer be used. Moreover, the Ming Dynasty is above it, the decrees are below, the officials sent out are loyal to their duties, and all directions are like spokes pointing towards the axis of the imperial court. Under such circumstances, how can anyone dare to rebel?

Therefore, they believed that, as reported by the Linzi County Sheriff, the people who jumped off the beam in Qiancheng and Di counties were just a group of thieves and were not worth mentioning. Presumably the governor and lieutenant of Linzi will be able to arrest them and hold them accountable soon, so the court does not need to rush to recruit troops.

Those who said they were rebels were afraid of real chaos in Qi, and those who said they were bandits wanted to please the emperor and deliberately belittled the rebels. As for the Linzi County Sheriff, if a major rebellion breaks out in his jurisdiction, he will be held accountable. This will not be the case for the bandits. As long as he handles the matter quickly enough and passes the source to Jiaodong, he may be able to avoid condemnation.

Finally, Qin Shihuang made the decision. "Whether it's banditry or rebellion, both are unforgivable!"

Qin Shihuang's journey to the East was very uncomfortable. Feng Chan was caught in the rain, Confucian scholars ridiculed, Alchemists cajoled, and then there was an almost successful murder. Of course, Qin Shihuang, who was safe and sound, while rewarding Zhao Gao, also believed that he Only with God's blessing can everything be fine.

In short, the emperor encountered too many troubles during this hunting trip. Now the assassin only killed famous warriors, and the mastermind has not been caught. He was angry in his heart, so he just imprisoned the suspected rangers in Donghai and Langya, and Anger cannot be quenched.

The current rebellion in Di County has added fuel to the fire and completely aroused the emperor's anger!

"In the past, among the six kingdoms, the ones who hated Qin the most were Zhao and Chu! I personally came to Handan and pitted hundreds of people against each other, but now no one in Zhao dares to rebel. Later, the old general Wang Jian swept across Chu and killed Xiang Yan. One hundred thousand prisoners were beheaded, and no one in the Chu region dared to resist. But it was the Qi region that surrendered without a fight, but countless troubles occurred!"

Qin Shihuang believed that this turmoil had nothing to do with the imperial policy, but was caused by the people of Qi being disorganized and making mistakes. The reason for this situation was that the Qin army was not sufficiently deterrent when it was unified...

Mencius believed that the world must be united, but only those who do not like to kill can unite.

The Qin Dynasty was unified, but it abandoned the kingly way and adopted the domineering and military way, taking murder as merit.

When Emperor Qin Shihuang consecrated Zen in Mount Tai, he also had the intention of picking up royal politics and cooperating with the scholars and nobles of Guandong, but all he got was disappointment.

It seems that it is necessary for Qi people to see what they missed during the unification war...

"I have made up my mind!"

Scanning the crowd, Qin Shihuang ordered: "Fire is fierce, and people look at it and fear it, so few people die; water is weak, and people play with it, and many people die..."

"Government should be lenient and gentle, and correction should be violent. The current chaos in Qi must be burned with fire, and then ruled with severe punishment and law!"

He has never been a kind king, and all the people of Qi must know...

The emperor's wrath laid down millions of corpses and bled thousands of miles!

So Qin Shihuang issued an order: "A gentleman will not stop his journey because of a villain, and I will not stop this world-carrying carriage just because a few praying mantises are blocking the way! Anyone who dares to stand in front of the carriage will , they will all be crushed into powder!"

He immediately sent people to the counties adjacent to Linzi and notified the local guards and lieutenants to strictly prevent the local fields from responding to the bandits and causing chaos. After suppressing the local area, if there is spare power, troops can be sent to support Linzi...

Especially Jiaodong! "Heifu vowed to wipe out the pirates within the year, and the evil wave in the East China Sea has passed. Now half a year has passed. Not only has he failed to contain the pirates, but he has also caused them to flee hundreds of miles into Linzi County and cause chaos. Heifu and Ren Xiao are here. do what?"

"Send someone to convey my edict. In advance, the three counties of Linzi, Jiaodong, and Jibei will cooperate to suppress it. Then the tiger talisman will be issued, and Ren Xiao will be ordered to use the boat division. Heifu will advance with chariots, horses, and infantry, both by water and land. If it cannot be pacified within one month. , then the army of Tongwuhou Wang Benshuai will join Qi! "

Qin Shihuang still has unspoken intentions. Heifu and others had better wipe out those so-called "bandits" before Tongwuhou's army arrives!

If not... these guards and lieutenants, together with the Langya guards and lieutenants who were implicated in the assassination case, can take off their official seals and go to jail to await their punishment!

And Jiaodong Shou Heifu will also deal with it, and...

Qin Shihuang slapped the case and said: "He could have changed his name that time, Fu Bo!"

…

"Okay, now we can't get away with it either."

On April 20th, this urgent letter from Eight Hundred Miles was delivered to Heifu. After reading it, Heifu shook his head and said: "Your Majesty is really angry, and the people of Qi will suffer. This time the rebellion will be suppressed. I'm afraid many people will die..."

Heifu and Chen Ping had the same view. The court was too aggressive in its administration and should be relaxed a little. Although he was extremely vicious in dealing with the Jiaodong fields, he was very generous to ordinary Guizhou leaders, especially the poorest leftists. He wanted to put down the chaos in the East China Sea, but also hoped that from now on, Jiaodong could recuperate and develop its productivity, which has increased. , many problems will no longer be problems.

But he did not expect that because of this rebellion, Qin Shihuang's dislike of the Qin Dynasty increased sharply. It seems that the central government's pressure on the Qin Dynasty will be heavier than before!

In the long run, it will be harmful to Jiaodong's New Deal, and it will also be unfavorable to dividing the rebels...

Heifu only feels a toothache. This is the disadvantage of history deviating from its original track. Do you want to predict events and take advantage of them? It's impossible. What he can do now is mostly to improvise.

But what made him even more uncomfortable was that this time he had to cooperate with the mentally retarded governor of Linzi County to suppress the rebellion.

The enemy is not scary, but the pig teammates are the most terrifying. It can be seen from the fact that Linzi County Sheriff blamed Jiaodong, and this is not enough to fight against.

Thinking like this, Heifu also asked Chen Ping: "Is there any new news about Linzi?"

Chen Ping reported: "There is no Junjun today."

More than half a month had passed since the turmoil. Following the fall of Qiancheng and Di counties, the rebels captured Le'an County north of Jishui. The Tian brothers had a high reputation in that area. For a time, four or five counties in the north of Jibei, Linzi County, had changed their flags one after another. The Tian brothers' army, composed of pirates, retainers, and light knights, numbered hundreds of chariots, hundreds of riders, and tens of thousands of soldiers...

This is the situation of the rebels. On the side of the Linzi official army, the Linzi County Guards could no longer bear the responsibility for losing land, so they divided the 7,000 county soldiers into two groups, 2,000 to guard Linzi, and the remaining 5,000, led by the county lieutenants, to garrison Bochang County, fifty miles northwest of Linzi, monitors the movement of Jishui. It seems that they want to hold the south of Jishui first and wait for reinforcements from various places to arrive before attacking...

"It was a wise move not to rush across the Jishui River to attack. We were outnumbered and outnumbered."

Heifu had been the county guard for more than a year, but he had not lost his old foundation of marching and fighting in the northwest. After scanning the map, he nodded slightly.

The longer the delay, the greater the strength of the rebels, and they may get a response from Moroda at any time, and more light warriors will continue to join, and the number will only increase. As for the Qin army, when they were not sure whether the Qi people would defect, they could only use foreign garrison troops to quell the rebellion, and they also had to be wary of the locals.

Now that Qin Shihuang's edict has been issued, all counties in Qi must strictly guard the fields. Only the Jiaodong fields have been gone. Before the imperial army could be assembled, the Jiaodong soldiers became the main force in countering the rebellion. Heifu, who was the county guard, even The opportunity to personally command the land division. "but……"

Hei Fu felt unhappy when he thought of the Linzi County Sheriff's face. "I really don't want to save him!"

…

In late April, Heifu mobilized his troops, leaving Chen Ping and others behind. He took Gong Ao, Cao Shen, and even mentioned Liu Ji to the army, and sent troops to march westward.

When we arrived at the border between the two counties, we heard new news from Linzi: "The rebels are going south, trying to cross the Jishui River and engage in battle with the soldiers of Linzi County!" "Yeah!"

Gong Ao suddenly shouted: "The Junjun told us that it is a taboo for military strategists to cross the river and attack. Those rebellious bandits really don't know how to fight. If they attack halfway across Linzi, won't the bandits be defeated? Will we? I'll be late." "No."

However, Heifu frowned after reading the written report from another team of scouts: "What I am most worried about now is whether the flag on the top of Linzi City when we arrive will be Qin or Qi!"
